question: Determine the magnitude and direction of the resultant force, either by CALCULATION or by ACCURATE CONSTRUCTION AND MEASUREMENT. (Use scale $10\text{ mm} = 50\text{ N}$.)
memo:
$F_x = P \cos 80^\circ + Q \cos 30^\circ + (-R \cos 60^\circ) = 500 \cos 80^\circ + 200 \cos 30^\circ - 300 \cos 60^\circ = 110,03\text{ N} \checkmark$
$F_y = P \sin 80^\circ + Q \sin 30^\circ + (-R \sin 60^\circ) = 500 \sin 80^\circ + 200 \sin 30^\circ - 300 \sin 60^\circ = 332,60\text{ N} \checkmark$
$F_R = \sqrt{110,03^2 + 332,60^2} = 350,33\text{ N} \checkmark$
$\theta = \tan^{-1}\left(\frac{332,60}{110,03}\right) = 71,69^\circ \checkmark$
Resultant force = $350,33\text{ N}$ in direction $N 18,31^\circ E$ (or $71,69^\circ$ North of East) $\checkmark$
